notes: BOM after a co-op board turndown (very NYC reason a deal dies). Uses 'back on' phrasing + 'board declined the previous purchaser'. Clear repricing-free return to market.

input.subject: Back on - 45 E 89th St #9C, UES (board turndown)
input.bodyText:
Broker network,

Unfortunately the co-op board declined the previous purchaser, so 45 E 89th St, Unit 9C is back on the market. No issue with the apartment - it was a financials thing on the buyer's end.

45 E 89th St, #9C, Upper East Side
1 bed / 1 bath co-op
Asking $735,000
Maintenance $1,180/mo, 50% financing allowed, pied-a-terre OK.

Would love to get this one closed. Co-broke standard. Reach out for a showing.

Greg Lang
Douglas Elliman
